note: Printed-item internal consistency, based on manually reviewed scans. Not an independent AI benchmark. No unique canonical tree is established. Original scoring files are retained as historical artifacts.

scoring_policy.group_policy: One physical shared sheet per group; participant rows share evidence.
scoring_policy.not_applicable: Confirmed stopped pure node: unused descendants are structural_na, excluded from scoring denominators.
scoring_policy.unknown: Missing extraction, ambiguous writing, missing verification evidence are unknown, never automatically blank or correct.
scoring_policy.decision_evidence: Accept explicit text or unambiguous class selection in the associated printed class line. Counts alone do not prove the predicted class.
scoring_policy.scope: Feature validity, complementary threshold pairs and local count/decision consistency. Does not verify optimal thresholds, fidelity to WS6 or actual dataset correctness.

dataset_note: Training/test card references and revised group-tree provenance are unavailable. Do not assume 8,11,14 or20 cards. Test-error correctness is unknown without independent reference.

total_policy: Verified subtotal over resolved applicable items only; total_score is null while applicable items remain unknown. Never present verified subtotal as a complete worksheet score.
